families.uncertainty_policy: ez-b004-uncertainty-v1: each prediction carries a Gaussian sigma built from two directly measured components and nothing else. Numerical uncertainty is |E(N_shells=16) - E(N_shells=14)| for that same nuclide. Parameter uncertainty is the change in the predicted mass when each fitted pairing strength moves by 10.0 MeV fm^3, combined in quadrature. Family disagreement is reported separately and never folded into a single family's sigma. A floor of 1 keV prevents a degenerate zero-width interval. No component is rescaled after truth unlock
